title_sq: Ne Astir, Tek Kompleksi Jolla, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Post Parkimi!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Tek Kompleksi Jolla, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Post Parkimi!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7-te te nje pallati me 8 kate i sapo perfunduar dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhomat e gjumit dhe tualeti. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode duke e bere nje mundesi shume te mire si per banim edhe per investim, pasi kerkesat per qira jane te larta. Kompleksi dallohet per cilesine e larte te punimeve.
title_en: In Astir, at the Jolla complex, 2+1 apartment for sale with parking!
description_en: In Astir, at the Jolla complex, 2+1 apartment for sale with parking!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a recently completed 8-story building and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, making it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment, as the demand for rent is high. The complex stands out for the high quality of the works.
